title: 第十一章 礼尚往来

content_zh:
所谓“下早朝”，其实也不过是晨起到金銮殿外例行公事地等候一会，有折子上折子，没事就当晨起锻炼，和各位大人打个招呼，想拉拢的多聊上几句，看着不顺眼的，字里行间里挤兑挤兑，然后大家各自散了，该干什么干什么去。
皇上忙着喝茶听戏喂鸟，没时间听他们掐架。
所以赫连翊到王府的时候，其实还很早。景七刚刚到人世之时，不过十岁，一张嘴就是奶音，偏偏说出来的话又是成人口气，偶尔几句叫人笑一笑他是小大人也就罢了，多了恐怕要要让人毛骨悚然的。
他又懒得装嫩，所以除了那一根肠子实心眼的傻平安，这些年越发不爱出门和人打交道。
对赫连翊本身还有些忌惮，连带着心里也有点爱答不理，成天懒洋洋一副没骨头睡不醒的模样。
久而久之，这太子殿下竟然还习惯了，只觉得这人自从老王爷没了，大病一场之后，看着是没什么了，到底还是年幼伤了底子，人看着总是有些乏，以前那么跳脱、满肚子坏水的一个人，这几年话都少了。
可见有时候误会也是有好处的。
景七被他进来的声音弄醒，迷迷糊糊地睁眼瞄了他一下，下意识地皱眉，裹上被子，翻身背对着他，接着睡。赫连翊来得很勤快，时间长了，大家都习惯了，景七也懒得和他再讲什么礼数。
太子殿下自然知道他不思进取混吃等死，一开始还仗着年长和身份说他几句，后来也看透了，这就是块朽木，摆着看看还好，当不了事。
然而毕竟是从小一起长大的交情，比亲兄弟还亲上几分，加上这人难得没有什么功利心，小小年纪又偏偏好静，倒是个躲闲偷懒的好地方。赫连翊有时觉着这朝中腥风血雨吹打得头痛了，便来这世外之地一般的王府坐上一会，走时心里也就安稳下来了。
所以赫连翊对他，向来是好脾气又有些耐性的，也不计较他无礼，伸手隔着被子拍拍他，笑道：“这是要到年底，准备出栏么？吃饱了睡睡饱了吃，猪囤膘都没你这么勤快，起来！”
又回头看了一眼还揉眼睛打哈欠的平安，摇摇头，心说果然有什么样的主，就有什么样的仆，懒到一块去了，吩咐道：“去给你家主子打水来，叫他好洗漱。”
平安应了一声，晃晃悠悠地出去了，赫连翊回过头来，一看景七那颇有“任你风吹浪打，我自岿然睡之”的模样，又气又笑，伸手在他身上用力拍了两记：“景北渊，起来！什么时辰了？我上了折子，父皇已经批下来了，叫你过了年便入朝听政了，到时候也这么惫懒不成么？”
景七叫他折腾得不行，迟缓地抱着被子坐起来：“入朝听政……”
“还不起来多用些功，回头好叫那帮酸溜溜的大学士们笑话你是纨绔子弟么？”
平安打了水进来，带着一个小厮叫吉祥的，端了洗漱的进来伺候景七更衣，赫连翊起身坐在一边，平安忙给他沏上茶。
景七任吉祥摆弄，好像没醒过盹来似的，半晌，才悠悠地道：“还请太子殿下再上个折子，叫圣上收回成命吧。”
赫连翊端起茶盅，略掀起一点盖子，挑眉看着他：“过了年便十五了，入朝是规矩，你不想做正事，要干什么去？”
景七掩面打了个哈欠，一双桃花似的眼睛半睁不睁，水汽氤氲的，瞧得赫连翊一愣，低头喝茶掩过，心中感慨，不知道什么时候，这人就从一个说话奶声奶气、却偏跟个小大人似的孩子，长成这么个芝兰玉树一般的少年，颦笑间带着些许倦怠的贵气，得了先王妃的俊俏，又得了老王爷的神韵，将来恐怕也是个叫满城怀/春少女们睡不着觉的人物。
然而只听这“芝兰玉树一般的美少年”略带了些鼻音，慢吞吞地说道：“干什么去……也没什么好差事，要么就求了皇上恩典，让我守皇陵去吧？”又打了个哈欠，手指擦去眼泪，“想什么时候睡就什么时候睡，想什么时候起就什么时候……”

他还没说完，赫连翊就把茶盅拍在了一边的小桌上，平安哆嗦了一下，迅速把被景七的惫懒相传染出来的一个哈欠咽了回去，低下头，不敢言声了。

content_en:
The so-called "morning court" is actually just a matter of getting up in the morning and waiting outside the Jinluan Palace for a while. If there is anything to do, you can exercise in the morning, say hello to all the adults, chat with those who want to win over, and chat with those who don't like it. Then everyone disperses and goes to do whatever they need to do.
The emperor was busy drinking tea, listening to operas and feeding birds, and had no time to listen to their fight.
So when Helianyi arrived at the palace, it was actually still very early. When Jing Qi first came into the world, he was only ten years old. He had a milky voice when he opened his mouth, but the words he spoke were in an adult tone. Occasionally, he could make people smile with a few words, but he was just a little adult. If he said more, it would probably make people's hair stand on end.
He was too lazy to pretend to be young, so except for the stupid Ping An with a solid heart and eyes, he became less and less fond of going out and interacting with people in recent years.
He was still a little afraid of He Lianyi, and he was also a little indifferent in his heart. He was lazy and sleepy all day long.
Over time, His Highness the Crown Prince got used to it, and I felt that since the old prince passed away and suffered a serious illness, this person looked like nothing. After all, it was his youth that hurt his foundation. He always looked a little tired. A person who used to be so out-of-the-box and full of bad ideas has said less in the past few years.
It can be seen that sometimes misunderstandings are beneficial.
Jing Qi was awakened by the sound of him coming in. She opened her eyes drowsily and glanced at him. She frowned subconsciously, wrapped herself in a quilt, turned her back to him, and continued to sleep. He Lianyi came very diligently, and over time, everyone got used to it, and Jing Qi didn't bother to talk to him about etiquette.
His Royal Highness naturally knew that he had no ambition to make progress and was waiting to die. At first, he used his age and status to say a few words to him, but later he saw clearly that he was just a piece of rotten wood.
However, after all, they grew up together and were closer than real brothers. In addition, this person rarely has any utilitarianism and prefers to be quiet at a young age. It is a good place to hide and laze. Sometimes He Lianyi felt that he had a headache from the chaos and bloodshed in the court, so he came to sit in the prince's palace, which was like a place outside the world, for a while, and when he left, he felt calm.
Therefore, Helian Yi was always good-tempered and patient towards him. He didn't care about his rudeness. He stretched out his hand to pat him through the quilt and said with a smile: "It's the end of the year. Are you ready to sell it? Eat enough, sleep well, eat enough. The pigs are not as diligent as you in hoarding fat. Get up!"
He looked back at Ping An, who was still rubbing his eyes and yawning. He shook his head and said to himself that as expected, there are servants just like any master. He was so lazy that he ordered: "Go and fetch water for your master so that he can wash himself."
Ping An responded and staggered out. He Lianyi turned around and saw Jing Qi's "Let the wind and waves beat you, I'll sleep calmly" look. He laughed angrily and reached out to slap him twice: "Jing Beiyuan, get up! What time is it? I'm in Zhezi. My father has already approved it and asked you to join the government after the New Year. Aren't you going to be so lazy by then?"
Jing Qi told him that he couldn't bear the trouble anymore and slowly sat up holding the quilt: "Enter the court to listen to politics..."
"Why don't you get up and work harder so that those sour academics can laugh at you for being a playboy?"
Ping An came in with water and brought a boy called Ji Xiang, who brought a wash dish to help Jing Qi change. He Lianyi got up and sat aside while Ping An hurriedly made tea for him.
Jing Qi let Jixiang play with it, as if he hadn't woken up from his nap. After a long while, he said leisurely: "Please give His Highness the Crown Prince another trick to ask the Holy One to take back his life."
He Lianyi picked up the tea cup, lifted the lid a little, and looked at him with raised eyebrows: "After the New Year, it will be fifteen. It is the rule to enter the court. If you don't want to do business, what are you going to do?"
Jing Qi covered her face and yawned, her peach-like eyes half-opened and filled with mist. Helianyi was stunned for a moment, lowered his head and drank tea to hide it.I sighed in my heart, I don't know when, this person grew up from a child who spoke in a milky voice, but acted like a little adult, to a young man who was as big as a orchid orchid tree, with a slightly tired nobility between his smiles. He got the beauty of the late princess, and the charm of the old prince. I am afraid that in the future, he will also be a figure that all the young girls in the city can't sleep at.
However, this "beautiful young man who is as beautiful as a orchid orchid tree" had a slightly nasal voice, and said slowly: "What are you going to do... there is nothing good to do, or you can ask for the emperor's grace and let me guard the imperial mausoleum?" He yawned again and wiped away his tears with his fingers, "I can go to bed whenever I want, and I can get up whenever I want..."
Before he finished speaking, Helianyi slapped the teacup on the small table beside him. Heping shuddered and quickly swallowed back a yawn that was infected by Jingqi's laziness. He lowered his head and did not dare to speak.
